rows.name:
Hey again! My curiosity got the better
of me, so I went over to the Great
Stairway myself to see what was up.

rows.label: tlk4330014501_msg0002
rows.name:
I found that Superbian from before
collapsed on the ground, so I took
the person to a doctor.

rows.label: tlk4330014501_msg0003
rows.name:
No need to thank me. Even if someone's
from the Empire, I can't just leave a
person lying there.
